name: io.github.rdoyle99/pie-chart-generator
title: Pie Chart Generator
description: Render pie, donut, and bar charts as SVG URLs or parse messy text and tables into chart slices.

tools.name: render_chart
tools.description: Calculate exact slice percentages and angles in degrees from category values, generate an executive slide takeaway, and return a live embeddable SVG chart image URL plus an interactive editor link on pie-chart-generator.com (where the user can customize colors or export PNG, SVG, PDF, or an editable 16:9 PowerPoint .pptx slide).

title.description: Chart title, e.g. "Q3 Revenue by Segment"

data.description: Categories and numeric values (2 to 16 items)

tools.name: parse_messy_data_to_chart
tools.description: Extract clean categories and numbers from messy text, Slack/email notes ($142.5k, $1.4M), Excel/Markdown tables (auto-stripping headers and Total rows), or tally raw categorical survey responses, returning exact percentages, degrees, and live chart URLs.

raw_text.description: Raw pasted spreadsheet text, paragraph with numbers, or newline-separated survey responses
